reason: The persisted R0 artifacts contain exclusionary causal language ('not a representation failure'). That phrasing overstates what the R0 evidence establishes: the decomposition shows the deployable failure is DOMINATED by intervention precision, but it does not establish that representation failure is excluded as a contributor.
canonical_wording: The observed Phase-13 deployable failure is dominated by poor intervention precision / off-target intervention burden. Existing evidence does not establish that representation failure is the primary limitation, but it also does not exclude localizer representation or score calibration as contributors.
superseded_phrasing: the failure is an intervention-precision failure, not a representation failure
what_remains_supported: 122 GT-hit proposals exist and 27 components are recovered with 0 component losses, so the existing localizer does produce usable targets
the off-target support fraction is the strongest descriptive associate of the FP burden (Spearman rho 0.5918 to 0.6372, consistent across all four architectures)
every label-blind marginal floor removes strictly more off-target than GT-hit proposals
therefore intervention precision is the dominant contributor to the deployable failure
what_is_not_established: that localizer representation quality is NOT a contributing limitation
that the proposal score is adequately calibrated
that fixing acceptance alone will recover the oracle benefit
implication_for_r1: H1 remains the correct FIRST experiment because it is the minimum-change test that can falsify the intervention-precision explanation. H1 failing would NOT by itself prove a representation failure; it would leave representation and score calibration as live candidates for H2.
